method: All 381 Cuts visually surveyed. Raster silhouette fits nominate candidates only; final rotations were reviewed against frame rules, horizontal hatching, bases or the filled outer oval axis. Positive angles rotate counterclockwise in positive-up font coordinates. No perspective warping or retracing. One separately recorded caption fragment in No. 70 is removed before rotation; every illustration contour is retained. Coordinates retained on a 1/64-unit grid.
